newsitem.title: USA: McKesson unit wins $500 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: McKesson unit wins $500 mln contract.

text.p: McKesson Corp on Tuesday said its unit, Medis Health and Pharmaceutical Services Inc of Montreal, has signed an agreement valued at US$500 million per year to provide health care distribution services

The contract with Drug Trading Co Ltd, based in Ontario, Canada, calls for Medis to provide Drug Trading's retail customers with services throughout Canada. It requires Medis purchase the inventory and accounts receivable of Drug Trading's Ontario and Atlantic distribution networks. Medis must also buy Drug Trading unit, Northwest Drug Ltd.
Terms of the deal were undisclosed.
In a statement, Medis said the deal must be approved by Drug Trading shareholders and Canadian regulators and is expected to close by August.

"This agreement represents a significant growth opportunity for Medis, and we expect the transaction to be accretive within the first year," said Claudio Bussandri, Medis chief executive officer. "Also, these agreements will improve Medis's operating margins and return on capital as operations are consolidated."
Medis is the largest distributor of pharmaceuticals and other pharmacy-related products in Canada, with annual revenues of about US$1.5 billion.
McKesson is the largest health care supply management company in North America.
